dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler from afar. Welcome to the Grand Narukami Shrine!

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: If you encounter any trouble or just want to make a wish, feel free to come here for a fortune slip. May the Electro Archon bless you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About drawing fortune slips...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Locals who want to make wishes often come here for fortune slips to seek the protection of our Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Although you are a Traveler from the outside world, you will still be blessed if you believe in her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everyone's wishes, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Yes... I've been in charge of greeting the people coming here for fortune slips for a while now, and I have heard all sorts of wishes from all manner of people.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Many who came here recently wished for the Sakoku Decree to be lifted soon...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: The Electro Archon... Hm, never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: As a shrine maiden, I should always follow and serve the Electro Archon. My life for the Eternal Narukami.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about the Grand Narukami Shrine?

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: The Grand Narukami Shrine is a place for making offerings and performing ceremonial affairs. Everything here is done according to the will of Her Excellency the Electro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Lady Yae Miko is the head shrine maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine. She is in charge of everything here.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: But Lady Yae is very busy indeed, and she is also the boss of Yae Publishing House. So when she is not around, I will take over some of her work.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: If you need any help from the shrine, feel free to ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: May the Electro Archon protect you! Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Cleansing Ritual...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Lady Yae did ask us to make some arrangements for the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Later, she said that new developments had precluded the need for us to continue our preparations. She even asked me to give the Memento Lens to a blond-haired outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: I never expected that the "new development" that Lady Yae mentioned was you.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: You have my thanks. I do not know how you managed it, but healing the Sacred Sakura was no mean feat. You have my utmost thanks as a shrine maiden of the Grand Narukami Shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Gendou Ringo...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Ah yes. I do believe that people have been saying that her attitude's gotten a lot better recently.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Although rather than calling it an attitude adjustment, it might be more accurate to say that "she seems like a different person," no?

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Haha. Not to worry, everyone at the shrine already knew, more or less.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Although I'm not privy to the details, if Lady Yae has allowed her to stay at the shrine, then she is someone we can trust.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everyone's wishes, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Yes... I've been in charge of greeting the people coming here for fortune slips for a while now, and I have heard all sorts of wishes from all manner of people.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Many have come lately to thank the Electro Archon for abolishing the country's closing, and to pray for a flourishing business or safe travels.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: As a shrine maiden, I should always follow and serve the Electro Archon. My life for the Eternal Narukami.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me about Hanachirusato...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Hanachirusato? I don't believe that any such person works at the Grand Narukami Shrine...

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, we found an antique kitsune mask while cleaning up the shrine hall. It seems to have once belonged to Lady Kitsune Saiguu.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, would you like to have it? Since you were the one who completed the Cleansing Ritual, I believe there must be some fate that ties you, Lady Saiguu, and the shrine together.

dialogues.speaker: Inagi Hotomi
dialogues.text: It's become a little fragile with its great age, so you can't really wear it, but I believe it must at least bear some sentiments and blessings from bygone years.
